To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the relation between positions in a personal construct is a dynamic, fluctuating relation, in which dominance reversals are the most striking and unexpected phenomenon.

dominance reversal is a phenomenon that can be described by the theory of personal constructs and can be studied by the method of repertory grid technique, that dominance reversal is an important phenomenon in the reorganization of the personal construct system, and that dominance reversal is the result of an active process in which a person tries to solve a dilemma by taking up a position that is not the most dominant one.

dominance reversal occurs in the context of an ongoing process in which a construct becomes a character and the self becomes a dialogical space in which the I fluctuates between positions in an ongoing process of self-organization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: What is the relation between the self and its constructs?
the question: What is the nature of the relation between constructs in the self?
the construction of the self in a dialogical manner.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a narrative approach to the self is a promising way to develop a theory of personal constructs.
a narrative approach to constructs leads to a dialogical conception, in which constructs are related as characters in a polyphonic novel.

the self is a dynamic and complex organization of contrasting positions, in which the dominance relation between positions is not stable but can be reversed in an apparently arbitrary fashion, leading to reorganizations of the self.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a dialogical self can be seen as a polyphonic novel in the mind.
a dialogical self theory can be developed in terms of the constructs and characters of a personal construct system.
the self is a dynamic and multivoiced entity that changes in time and space, and that it is a dialogical entity in which the poles are in constant interaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a dialogical self theory is a powerful tool for understanding the dynamics of self-organization and reorganization.

, in the dialogical self, the I fluctuation is a process of self-organization that is not necessarily directed toward the creation of an ideal self, but rather toward a self that is capable of coping with the challenges of life.
the dialogical self is an emergent, dynamic process.
